# Brex — account brief

## Who

Brex offers corporate cards and spend management software for startups and enterprises ([source](https://brex.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Brex at brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- The app runs react-native 0.74.5 per package.json ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows configured ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 27 public repos and 410 followers ([source](https://github.com/brexhq))
- brexhq/brex-mobile last pushed 2026-08-15 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile))
- The iOS app has 28,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141))
- There have been 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141))
- The org description names a regulated category, "financial" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq))
- An open issue reads "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@brexhq-maintainer-1), top contributor to brexhq/brex-mobile with 260 commits; profile lists company "Brex" and website https://brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@brexhq-maintainer-2), top contributor to brexhq/brex-mobile with 133 commits; profile lists company "Brex" and website https://brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2))
- @brexhq-maintainer-3, top contributor to brexhq/brex-mobile with 58 commits ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-3))

## Why now

brexhq/brex-mobile last pushed 2026-08-15 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile)), and the App Store listing shows 7 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)) with an open issue titled "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, you have 260 commits in brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)), which ships 7 App Store releases in a 90-day window ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)) off react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)). I saw issue 87, "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)), still open alongside your CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)). What is holding the SDK 52 native module mismatch open in your current build pipeline?
